method: 0.1 mm or finer curve samples. Euclidean point-to-COTS-AABB and full installed HDMI segment-AABB distances. Power distance is nearest dense source sample minus both radii. Tool screen uses finite-axis capsules with full specified radius. Small sampled distances are nominal estimates and not mechanical tolerances. Full junction AABB is checked separately; terminal contacts remain explicit.
